pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's lemma environment at source lines 24226-24239 (label lemma-characterize-flatness-on-torsion, canonical tag 05E7): flatness with faithful flatness of the quotients by the powers of an ideal, flatness with surjectivity on the spectra of those quotients, flatness with faithfulness of base change on modules annihilated by the ideal, and flatness with faithfulness on all power torsion modules are equivalent. The proof environment at source lines 24241-24261 immediately follows it and is its own proof: flatness descends to the quotients, the faithful flatness criterion gives the first equivalence, modules annihilated by the ideal are identified with modules over the quotient to get the third condition, and an arbitrary power torsion module is written as a union of the modules annihilated by the successive powers, so the last condition follows from the previous one by commutativity of the tensor product with colimits.
